---
title: v2.2.8 — Improved Windows Release E2E Cleanup and Diagnostics
---

## Overview

This release improves cancellation and timeout handling in Windows release installation verification. It adds bounded process tree cleanup checks, clearer diagnostics for interrupted runs, and tests for descendant processes and firewall cleanup failures.

## Highlights

- Run the Windows cancellation and timeout tests on the native Windows package job, including checks that installer descendants do not keep running.
- Report process tree cleanup failures and retain the original E2E error when firewall cleanup also fails.
- Record the installer scenario and timing when a release installation verification is interrupted.
